name: phenoUtils
absorption_note: Keep phenoUtils as the canonical parent for its six foundational Rust crates. phenotype-shared remains a candidate integration target only; no source/API parity proof exists for subtree absorption.
rationale: Active public MIT-licensed Rust workspace with six explicit crate members (pheno-shell, pheno-fs, pheno-crypto, pheno-net, pheno-testing, pheno-schema-port) and 24 remote branches. Its primitive boundary is distinct from phenotype-shared's current manifest and should not be flattened without a crate-by-crate parity review.
note: Remote is active and unarchived; no local repos/phenoUtils checkout was present during this audit. Cargo workspace validation currently fails because the virtual manifest contains a forbidden root [dependencies] section; preserve this finding for source-owner remediation.
